idea: Lily hides daddy's phone and acts innocent
title: Where's My Phone?
description: The phone was in the toy oven. Obviously.

scenes.image_prompt: Living room. The dad searches under the sofa cushions with a confused frustrated face. Behind him the little girl sits very straight on a chair with her hands folded and a super innocent angelic smile. Medium wide shot.
scenes.action: The dad digs under the sofa cushions; behind him the little girl swings her legs and smiles innocently.

dialogue.speaker: daddy
dialogue.line: Lily, have you seen Daddy's phone?

scenes.image_prompt: Living room. Close-up of the little girl with a too-innocent smile, eyes looking sideways toward a pink toy kitchen oven, from which a phone is glowing and ringing. The dad leans in suspiciously. Close two-shot.
scenes.action: The toy oven glows and buzzes; the little girl's eyes dart toward it; the dad leans closer suspiciously.

dialogue.speaker: daddy
dialogue.line: Then why is your oven ringing?

scenes.image_prompt: Living room. The dad holds his phone, which is covered in stickers and wrapped in a tiny blanket. The little girl giggles. The dad laughs and lifts her up. Warm close-up.
scenes.action: The dad unwraps the phone from a tiny blanket; the little girl giggles and he scoops her up.

dialogue.speaker: lily
dialogue.line: Phone was cold. I make it cozy!
